tools.name: billomat_get_current_user
tools.description: Show the Billomat user the API key belongs to (name, email, role and rights). Use it to check which rights the key has.

tools.name: billomat_get_company
tools.description: Show the own company data of the Billomat account (name, address, bank details, tax numbers, currency).

tools.name: billomat_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients (customers) of the account, filtered by name, number, email, contact person, country, note or tags. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_client
tools.description: Get one client with address, contact person, bank details, payment terms and revenue.

tools.name: billomat_list_articles
tools.description: List the articles (products and services) with prices, units and tax. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_article
tools.description: Get one article with its prices, unit, tax and supplier.

tools.name: billomat_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers of the account, filtered by name, email, contact person, country, note or tags. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier with address and bank details.

tools.name: billomat_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices (Rechnungen), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, OPEN, PAID, OVERDUE, CANCELED), number, date range, text or tags. Paged; each invoice carries totals and the open amount.

tools.name: billomat_invoice_totals
tools.description: Invoice totals grouped by client, status, day, week, month or year (for example group_by=client,year). Takes the same filters as billomat_list_invoices. Read-only.

tools.name: billomat_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice (status, totals, dates, client, payment terms). Its line items come from billomat_list_invoice_items.

tools.name: billomat_list_invoice_items
tools.description: List the line items (positions) of one invoice.

tools.name: billomat_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments that were recorded on invoices (read-only), optionally for one invoice, a date range or payment types.

tools.name: billomat_list_recurring_invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoices (Abo-Rechnungen): name, cycle (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY), client and next run. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_list_offers
tools.description: List offers (Angebote), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, OPEN, WON, LOST, CANCELED, CLEARED), number, date range or text. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_offer
tools.description: Get one offer (status, totals, validity, client).

tools.name: billomat_list_confirmations
tools.description: List order confirmations (Auftragsbestaetigungen), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, COMPLETED, CANCELED, CLEARED), number, date range or text. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_confirmation
tools.description: Get one order confirmation.

tools.name: billomat_list_delivery_notes
tools.description: List delivery notes (Lieferscheine), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, CREATED), number, date range or text. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_delivery_note
tools.description: Get one delivery note.

tools.name: billomat_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List credit notes (Gutschriften), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, OPEN, PAID), date range or text. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_credit_note
tools.description: Get one credit note.

tools.name: billomat_list_reminders
tools.description: List payment reminders (Mahnungen), filtered by client, status (DRAFT, OPEN, OVERDUE, PAID, CANCELED), invoice number, date range or text. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_reminder
tools.description: Get one payment reminder.

tools.name: billomat_list_incoming_invoices
tools.description: List incoming invoices (Eingangsrechnungen, from suppliers), filtered by supplier, status (OPEN, PAID, OVERDUE), number, date range, note or tags. Paged.

tools.name: billomat_get_incoming_invoice
tools.description: Get one incoming invoice with amounts and open amount.

tools.name: billomat_list_taxes
tools.description: List the tax rates (Steuersaetze) of the account, with the default one.

tools.name: billomat_list_units
tools.description: List the units (Einheiten) used for article and item quantities, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: billomat_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: create a new client (customer) in Billomat. Billomat assigns the client number. Nothing is sent to the client. Check billomat_list_clients first to avoid duplicates.

tools.name: billomat_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing client (only the fields you pass are changed; everything else stays). Read the client first with billomat_get_client. Nothing is sent to the client.

tools.name: billomat_create_article
tools.description: WRITE: create a new article (product or service) with a price. Billomat assigns the article number.

tools.name: billomat_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create an invoice as a DRAFT (Entwurf) for a client, with optional line items. The invoice is NOT completed, has no number yet and is NOT sent; review and complete it in Billomat. Nothing is charged.

tools.name: billomat_add_invoice_item
tools.description: WRITE: add one line item to an invoice that is still a DRAFT (Billomat refuses it for any other status). Does not complete or send the invoice.

tools.name: billomat_create_draft_offer
tools.description: WRITE: create an offer (Angebot) as a DRAFT for a client, with optional line items. The offer is NOT completed, has no number yet and is NOT sent; review and complete it in Billomat.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: billomat_get_current_user, billomat_list_clients, billomat_list_suppliers · Private data: billomat_get_current_user, billomat_list_clients, billomat_get_client, billomat_list_suppliers · Public sink: billomat_get_current_user, billomat_list_clients, billomat_list_suppliers, billomat_add_invoice_item · Destructive: billomat_list_recurring_invoices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: billomat_get_current_user, billomat_list_clients, billomat_list_suppliers · Private data: billomat_get_current_user, billomat_list_clients, billomat_get_client, billomat_list_suppliers · Public sink: billomat_get_current_user, billomat_list_clients, billomat_list_suppliers, billomat_add_invoice_item · Destructive: billomat_list_recurring_invoices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
